selected_records.title: A Decision-Focused Neural Optimization Framework for Personalized Route Reproduction from Vehicle Trajectories

article.body:
Vehicle-trajectory route-reproduction paper lacks production capacity details

The arXiv paper "A Decision-Focused Neural Optimization Framework for Personalized Route Reproduction from Vehicle Trajectories" focuses on route reproduction using vehicle trajectories. The paper does not specify a facility, production line, or infrastructure system, nor does it provide evidence for production figures, capacity, or physical constraints. No supply-chain implications are established.
